name: Acero Ornamental & Iron Works
old_description: "We have trusted Sam and Caesar with every project at our home. Their reliability, attention to detail, and dedication to customer satisfaction are what matters most to us."
about:
Acero Ornamental & Iron Works operates from Freehold, New Jersey. The company was founded by Sam and Caesar, who are referenced in client testimonials as the principals behind the business. No founding year is publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom iron, aluminum, stainless steel, and bronze metalwork for both residential and commercial projects. Its capabilities span design, fabrication, and installation of railings, fencing, doors, gates, stair railings, entrance gates, and ornamental pieces. The company describes its process as a full-service operation that handles design, fabrication, and installation in-house.

Acero serves homeowners and businesses across New Jersey, with a commercial client list that includes restaurants and retail establishments such as Cubacan, Indikitch, iPlay, Johnny Utah's, and UpRoot. Residential work covers stair railings, entrance gates, and fencing.

The company emphasizes a turnkey approach—design, fabricate, and install everything under one roof—and highlights reliability, attention to detail, and dedication to customer satisfaction as distinguishing traits.
